summary: Fix interval merging bugs (touching ranges, contained ranges, zero-length) behind wrong free-slot results without breaking conflict detection.
what_tests_check: merge combines touching intervals, keeps the outer end for contained ones, drops zero-length ones; free_slots/total_busy match a minute-grid brute force on random inputs; min_minutes inclusive, clipping, tuples; back-to-back bookings still not conflicts (trap: changing overlaps()).
